results.content:
An Economist/YouGov poll released Aug. 11 found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump’s job performance, a 3-percentage-point drop from the previous week, reported USA TODAY. The latest figure marks Trump’s lowest approval rating in YouGov polling since he returned to the White House in 2025. [...] The economy continues to weigh on Trump’s approval numbers, as it has in several recent polls. The Economist/YouGov poll found that just 22% of Americans rate the economy as excellent or good, while only 14% say economic conditions are improving.

Meanwhile, more than half of Americans — 56% — believe the economy is getting worse.

Americans' approval of Donald Trump's job performance continues to decline, according to the July 25 - 27 Economist / YouGov Poll. 34% of U.S. adult citizens strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, tied for a record low for either Trump term, while a record 62% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -28, also a record low.

At this point in Trump's first term, he had a net job approval of -9. [...] Among white Americans without college degrees, 43% approve of Trump and 52% disapprove. results.content:
July 21, 2026

The latest Economist / YouGov Poll shows that Donald Trump remains unpopular, with 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approving of Trump's job performance and 60% disapproving. That net job approval of -24 is near the lowest Trump has recorded in his second term, and below both the lowest net approval of Trump in his first term and the lowest of Joe Biden in his term.

Trump's net approval among men is -22, the lowest in either of his terms.
